description: ERC-20 transfers into and out of an address in a window of recent blocks (default 2,000, max 10,000), from Transfer logs, newest first, max 100 rows with token symbols. token limits the search to one contract. A busy address can be truncated: narrow the window to see the rest. Related tools on this server, for a different need: evm_balance when you need ERC-20 balance of an address for one token contract; evm_address when you need Native balance, nonce and account type of an EVM address. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

blocks.description: Blocks to search back from the latest (max 10000)

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon

name: evm_transfers
title: List ERC-20 transfers for an address in recent blocks
